warranty.notes: Australia: 60% of usable energy at 15 years (5 years basic plus 10 years advanced) or 28.84 MWh life cycle discharge per 6.9 kWh battery pack, whichever comes first. Counted from installation (the policy's start of 180 days after shipment is ignored). The advanced 10 years are void if the system isn't connected to FusionSolar after power-on or is disconnected for over six months. The power module (LUNA2000-10KW-C1) has its own time-only 15-year warranty.

Huawei LUNA2000-S1 specifications (tower and inverter limits)

notes: LUNA2000-7/14/21-S1: one LUNA2000-10KW-C1 power module with 1-3 LUNA2000-7-E1 modules of 6.9 kWh, 100% usable; up to 4 towers per SUN2000-MB0 inverter (2 on other inverters) and up to 3 inverters: at most 12 towers (36 modules, 252 kWh) with 3 paralleled MB0 inverters. 5 kWh and 6.9 kWh S1 modules can share a tower; S0 and S1 can't be mixed on one inverter or in one cascaded system. Sold in Australia as the iStore IS-BATT-7000. The 5 kWh S1 module (LUNA2000-5-E1) is warranted for Europe only.
